name: District and taluk boundaries — bengaluru
organisation: Local Government Directory (LGD) and Survey of India, via the india-geodata community compilation
attribution: Boundaries from LGD / Survey of India via india-geodata (CC0)
transformation: National sub-district file streamed and filtered to each city's bounding box; coordinates rounded to 5 dp; ALL-CAPS names title-cased for consistent rendering (casing only — no name was corrected or remapped)
caveats: REPUBLISHED, NOT OFFICIAL. LGD and Survey of India are the upstream authorities; this project retrieved a community compilation of them, so it is T3 and reported as INDICATIVE.
VINTAGE IS NOT STATED per feature. Karnataka and Tamil Nadu have both reorganised taluks in recent years, so a name here may predate a reorganisation.
THIS LAYER CANNOT PRODUCE A SURVEY NUMBER. It answers which taluk a point falls in. Survey number remains sourced from the revenue sheets and stays UNAVAILABLE outside their footprint.
Hobli is not an LGD level and is not present in this layer. It remains available only where a revenue sheet covers the point.
